checks.d: Sentence rhythms and phrasing that often signal generated text.
Overused stock phrases and recycled structures.
Writing that lacks a clear authorial perspective.
Logic gaps, weak transitions, and unfocused paragraphs.
Missing, inconsistent, or incorrectly formatted sources.
Text that reads unnaturally smooth or detached.
Claims that aren't backed by data, examples, or sources.
Patterns that may concern instructors or reviewers.

writingCheck.consent: I understand that StudyHuman does not guarantee 100% AI detection accuracy. This service provides human feedback on writing style, originality concerns, citation quality, structure, and academic integrity.
writingCheck.disclaimer: AI detection tools can produce false positives and false negatives. StudyHuman does not claim to prove whether a text was written by AI. Instead, our reviewers provide careful human feedback on whether the writing sounds overly generic, robotic, unsupported, poorly cited, or inconsistent with academic expectations.
